abash.en: to make shy or ashamed; abashed: held back by shyness or modesty

acyuta.hi: अच्युत, 'जो कभी न गिरे', विष्णु (श्रीकृष्ण)का नाम
acyuta.en: Acyuta, 'the one who never falls', a name of Viṣṇu (Kṛṣṇa)

adamantine.en: hard and unbreakable as a diamond (vajra)

adept.en: one who has mastered a discipline; a siddha

aditi.hi: अदिति, देवताओंकी माता; कठोपनिषद्‌में सबको खानेवाली (भोगनेवाली)
aditi.en: Aditi, mother of the gods; in the Kaṭha Upaniṣad, she who eats (enjoys) all

adze.en: a carpenter's cutting tool, its blade set across the handle

aeon.en: a very long age; a kalpa, an age of the world

agastya.hi: अगस्त्य, घड़ेसे उत्पन्न महान् मुनि (कुम्भज), जिनसे श्रीराम वनमें मिले
agastya.en: Agastya, the great sage born from a pitcher, whom Śrī Rāma visited in the forest

ahirāvaṇa.hi: अहिरावण, पातालका राक्षस, जो राम-लक्ष्मणको उठा ले गया; हनुमान्‌जीने उसे मारा
ahirāvaṇa.en: Ahirāvaṇa, a demon of the netherworld who carried off Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa; Hanumān slew him

akampana.en: Akampana, a demon warrior of Rāvaṇa's army

akṣaya.hi: अक्षय (अक्षयकुमार), रावणका पुत्र, जिसे हनुमान्‌जीने अशोकवाटिकामें मारा
akṣaya.en: Akṣaya (Akṣaya Kumāra), a son of Rāvaṇa, slain by Hanumān in the Aśoka grove

alms.en: food or money given to a beggar or a holy man

aloe.hi: अगर (अगरु), सुगन्धित लकड़ी, जो धूपमें जलती है
aloe.en: aloe-wood: agaru, a fragrant wood burnt as incense (not the aloe plant)

ambikā.en: Ambikā, 'the Mother', a name of Pārvatī, Śiva's wife

ananta.en: Ananta, 'the endless', the serpent Śeṣa; in the Mānas, Lakṣmaṇa

anasūyā.hi: अनसूया, अत्रि मुनिकी पत्नी, पतिव्रताओंमें श्रेष्ठ; उन्होंने सीताजीको स्त्रीधर्म सुनाया; दत्तात्रेय उनके पुत्र हैं
anasūyā.en: Anasūyā, wife of the sage Atri, a model of devotion to her husband; she taught Sītā a wife's dharma, and Datta is her son

angler.en: one who fishes with a rod and line

apsarā.en: an apsarā, a heavenly dancer, one of the nymphs of Indra's court

apāna.hi: अपान, नीचेकी ओर चलनेवाला प्राण, शरीरके प्राणोंमेंसे एक
apāna.en: apāna, the breath that moves downward, one of the body's breaths

arka.hi: आक (मदार) का पौधा / श्रीरुद्रममें अर्क, बड़े यज्ञ-कर्मकी पवित्र अग्नि
arka.en: the arka plant (madar, a milkweed) / in the Rudram, the arka: the sacred fire of a great rite

array.hi: समूह, ठाठ / सजावट, शृंगार / सेनाकी पाँत; सजना, धारण करना
array.en: a fine show; a whole set or display / dress, finery / an ordered line of troops; arraying oneself: dressing, putting on

arundhatī.en: Arundhatī, the wife of the sage Vasiṣṭha, honoured for her faithfulness

ascetic.en: one who gives up comforts to live a strict, holy life

asura.en: an asura, a demon, foe of the gods

atikāya.hi: अतिकाय, रावणका पुत्र, एक बलवान् राक्षस योद्धा
atikāya.en: Atikāya ("huge-bodied"), a son of Rāvaṇa and a mighty demon warrior

atri.hi: अत्रि, अनसूयाके पति मुनि, जिनके चित्रकूटके पासके आश्रममें श्रीराम गये
atri.en: Atri, the sage, husband of Anasūyā, whose hermitage near Citrakūṭa Śrī Rāma visited

attributeless.en: without attributes or qualities; God beyond all form

austerity.en: hard self-discipline undertaken for a spiritual end

avadh.hi: अवध, श्रीरामकी नगरी अयोध्या और उसका प्रदेश
avadh.en: Avadh, Ayodhyā, Śrī Rāma's city, and the land around it

avikṣit.hi: अविक्षित्, एक प्राचीन राजा, राजा मरुत्तके पिता
avikṣit.en: Avikṣit, an ancient king, father of King Marutta

aśoka.hi: अशोक वृक्ष; अशोक वाटिका, लंकामें रावणका बगीचा जहाँ सीताजीको रखा गया
aśoka.en: the aśoka tree ("free of sorrow"); the Aśoka grove, Rāvaṇa's garden in Laṅkā where Sītā was kept

aśvattha.hi: अश्वत्थ, पीपलका वृक्ष; कठोपनिषद्‌में संसाररूपी वृक्ष
aśvattha.en: the aśvattha, the holy fig tree (pīpal); in the Kaṭha Upaniṣad, the tree of the world

aśvin.en: the Aśvins, twin gods, the physicians of the gods

aṅgada.hi: अंगद, बालिके पुत्र, वानरोंके युवराज, श्रीरामकी सेनाके वीर
aṅgada.en: Aṅgada, son of Vāli, crown prince of the monkeys and a hero of Śrī Rāma's army

badarī.hi: बदरी वन, हिमालयमें बेरके वृक्षोंका पवित्र वन (बदरिकाश्रम)
badarī.en: Badarī, the forest of jujube trees in the Himālayas, a holy place (Badarikāśrama)

bael.hi: बेल (बिल्व) का वृक्ष और उसका फल
bael.en: the bael (bilva) tree and its round, hard-shelled fruit

bali.hi: बलि, दैत्योंके दानी राजा, जिन्हें वामनरूप विष्णुने बाँधा
bali.en: Bali, the demon king, a great giver, whom Viṣṇu as Vāmana bound

beguile.en: to deceive, to trick by charm

betel.hi: पान; किसीको बीड़ा देना, उसे कोई काम सौंपना
betel.en: the betel leaf, chewed with areca nut; to give someone the betel roll (bīṛā) is to entrust him with a task

bhagauti.en: a Bhagauti, a worshipper of the Lord, devoted to him

bhagavad.en: of the Lord; the Bhagavad Gītā, "the Song of the Lord"

bhagīratha.hi: भगीरथ, श्रीरामके पूर्वज एक राजा, जो तपसे गंगाजीको स्वर्गसे पृथ्वीपर लाये
bhagīratha.en: Bhagīratha, a king of Śrī Rāma's line who by his penance brought the Gaṅgā down from heaven to earth

bharadvāja.hi: भरद्वाज, प्रयागके महामुनि, जिनके आश्रममें वन जाते समय श्रीराम गये
bharadvāja.en: Bharadvāja, the great sage of Prayāga, whose hermitage Śrī Rāma visited on his way to the forest

bhava.hi: भव, रुद्र (शिव)का नाम, जिनसे सब प्राणी उत्पन्न होते हैं; 'भव' (बहुवचन), अनेक रुद्र
bhava.en: Bhava, a name of Rudra-Śiva, from whom all beings arise; 'the Bhavas', the many Rudras

bhavānī.hi: भवानी, पार्वतीजी, शिवजीकी पत्नी, जिन्हें शिवजी मानसकी कथा सुनाते हैं
bhavānī.en: Bhavānī, Pārvatī, Śiva's wife, to whom Śiva tells the Mānas

bheda.hi: भेद, फूट; शत्रुओंमें फूट डालना (राजनीतिका एक उपाय) / नृत्य-संगीतमें सुर-तालके भेद (प्रकार)
bheda.en: division, difference; sowing discord among foes (a means of statecraft) / in dance and music, the divisions (varieties) of tune and beat

bhil.en: the Bhils, a forest people of central and western India

bhāra.hi: भार, बोझ (एक माप); अठारह भार वनस्पति, अर्थात् सारी वनस्पति
bhāra.en: a load, a great weight (a measure); "the eighteen bhāras of plants" means all the plants of the world

bhūta.en: a spirit, a goblin; the bhūtas are among Śiva's attendants

bhṛgu.hi: भृगु मुनि; उन्होंने विष्णुकी छातीपर लात मारी, जिसका चिह्न भगवान् धारण करते हैं
bhṛgu.en: Bhṛgu, a great sage; he struck Viṣṇu on the chest with his foot, and Viṣṇu bears its mark

bhṛṅga.hi: भृंगी, कीड़ेको पकड़नेवाला एक कीट; कहते हैं, कीड़ा उसीका ध्यान करते-करते भृंगी बन जाता है
bhṛṅga.en: the bhṛṅga, a wasp that seizes a grub; the grub, ever thinking of it, is said to become a wasp itself

bier.en: a frame on which a dead body is carried

bilva.hi: बिल्व (बेल)का पेड़, जिसके तीन पत्तोंवाले दल शिवजीपर चढ़ाये जाते हैं
bilva.en: the bilva (bel) tree, whose leaves, in sets of three leaflets, are offered to Śiva

bilvāṣṭaka.hi: बिल्वाष्टक, शिवजीको चढ़ाये बिल्वपत्रकी आठ श्लोकोंकी स्तुति
bilvāṣṭaka.en: the Bilvāṣṭaka, the hymn of eight verses on the bilva leaf offered to Śiva

bilvāṣṭakam.hi: बिल्वाष्टकम्, शिवजीको चढ़ाये बिल्वपत्रकी आठ श्लोकोंकी स्तुति
bilvāṣṭakam.en: the Bilvāṣṭakam, the hymn of eight verses on the bilva leaf offered to Śiva

brahm.hi: ब्रह्म, सर्वव्यापक परमात्मा; ब्रह्मज्ञानी, परमात्माको जाननेवाला
brahm.en: God, the all-pervading Lord (Brahman); a Brahm Giani is one who knows God

brahmacārī.en: a celibate student of the Vedas

brahman.en: Brahman, the one supreme reality behind all that is
brahman.hi: ब्रह्म, सबके मूलमें रहनेवाला एक परम सत्य

brahmaṇaspati.hi: ब्रह्मणस्पति, प्रार्थना (मन्त्रों) के स्वामी देवता, बृहस्पति
brahmaṇaspati.en: Brahmaṇaspati, lord of prayer, the god of sacred speech (Bṛhaspati)

brahmin.en: a member of the priestly class, learned in the Vedas

bridgehead.hi: पुलका सिरा, जहाँ वह किनारेसे मिलता है
bridgehead.en: the end of a bridge, where it meets the land

brāhmaṇa.en: a member of the priestly class, learned in the Vedas

bābā.hi: संतके लिये प्रेम और आदरभरा सम्बोधन (शब्दार्थ: पिता); यहाँ शिरडीके साईं बाबा
bābā.en: a loving name for a holy man (literally 'father'); here Sāī Bābā of Shirdi

bṛhaspati.en: Bṛhaspati, the guru of the gods

cakavā.hi: चकवा पक्षी; कहते हैं, चकवा-चकवी रातमें बिछुड़ जाते हैं
cakavā.en: the cakavā (cakravāka, the ruddy shelduck); its pairs are said to be parted every night

cakora.hi: चकोर, चन्द्रमाको एकटक देखनेवाला और चाँदनी पीनेवाला माना गया पक्षी
cakora.en: the cakora, a partridge said to live on moonbeams, gazing ever at the moon

cakravāka.hi: चकवा, जिसका जोड़ा रातमें बिछुड़ जाता और सवेरेकी राह देखता माना जाता है
cakravāka.en: the cakravāka, the ruddy goose; the pair are said to be parted every night and to long for dawn

cakravākī.hi: चकवी; रातमें अपने साथीसे बिछुड़ी, दिनमें मिलकर प्रसन्न रहती है
cakravākī.en: the female cakravāka bird; parted from her mate at night, she is joyful by day when they meet

campaka.hi: चम्पाका वृक्ष, सुगन्धित पीले फूलोंवाला; कहते हैं, भौंरा उसपर नहीं बैठता
campaka.en: the campaka tree, with fragrant yellow flowers; bees are said to shun it

candrabhāgā.hi: चन्द्रभागा, पंढरपुरके पास बहनेवाली भीमा नदी
candrabhāgā.en: the Candrabhāgā, the river Bhīmā as it flows past Paṇḍharpur

castor.hi: अंडी (रेंड) का पौधा, एक तुच्छ पौधा
castor.en: the castor plant, a common, worthless shrub

celibate.en: one who keeps from sexual life; a brahmacārī

chālīsā.en: a hymn of forty verses, such as the Hanumān Chālīsā

citrakūṭa.hi: चित्रकूट, वह पर्वत और वन जहाँ श्रीराम वनवासमें रहे
citrakūṭa.en: Citrakūṭa, the hill and forest where Śrī Rāma lived in his exile

citta.en: the mind as the store of thought and memory; the inner heart

conciliation.hi: साम, मीठे वचनोंसे मनाना; राजाके चार उपायोंमें पहला
conciliation.en: winning someone over with gentle words (sāma), the first of a king's four ways

consecration.en: anointing as king (abhiṣeka) / initiation for a sacrifice (dīkṣā)

cosmos.en: the whole universe, as one ordered whole

covet.en: to long for what belongs to another

cowrie.en: a small sea shell, once used as money of the least value

cātaka.hi: चातक, पपीहा, जो केवल बादलकी बूँदें पीता माना जाता है
cātaka.en: the cātaka, a cuckoo said to drink only raindrops from the clouds

dadhīci.hi: दधीचि, वे मुनि जिन्होंने अपना शरीर दे दिया, जिससे उनकी हड्डियोंसे इन्द्रका वज्र बना
dadhīci.en: Dadhīci, the sage who gave up his body so that his bones could make Indra's thunderbolt

dakṣa.hi: दक्ष प्रजापति, सतीजीके पिता; उनके यज्ञमें शिवजीका अपमान हुआ और सतीने वहीं देह त्यागी
dakṣa.en: Dakṣa, a Prajāpati, father of Satī; Śiva was slighted at his sacrifice, and Satī gave up her body there

datta.hi: दत्त (दत्तात्रेय), अत्रि और अनसूयाके पुत्र, जिनमें ब्रह्मा, विष्णु और शिव एक हैं; साईं बाबा उन्हींके रूप माने जाते हैं
datta.en: Datta (Dattātreya), son of Atri and Anasūyā, in whom Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Śiva are one; Sāī Bābā is seen as him

daśaratha.en: Daśaratha, king of Ayodhyā, Śrī Rāma's father

daṇḍa.hi: डंडा; दण्ड, बलका प्रयोग (राजाके चार उपायोंमें एक) / घड़ी, लगभग चौबीस मिनटका समय
daṇḍa.en: a rod or staff; punishment, the use of force (one of a king's four ways) / a measure of time, about twenty-four minutes

daṇḍaka.hi: दण्डकवन, दक्षिणका बड़ा वन, जहाँ श्रीरामने वनवासका बड़ा भाग बिताया
daṇḍaka.en: the Daṇḍaka forest, the wide forest of the south where Śrī Rāma spent much of his exile

deference.en: respect; giving way to another out of respect

delusion.en: a false belief; a clouded, confused mind

demonic.en: of the demons (asuras); dark and evil

deva.en: a god, a shining one; in the Upaniṣads also the senses

dharma.hi: धर्म; कर्तव्य, सदाचार; किसी युग, वर्ण या स्थितिका अपना धर्म
dharma.en: the right way of living that upholds the world: duty, righteousness; also the particular duty of an age, class or role

dhātṛ.hi: धाता, सृष्टि करने और धारण करनेवाले देवता
dhātṛ.en: Dhātṛ, the Creator, the god who establishes and upholds all

digambara.hi: दिगम्बर, दिशाएँ ही जिसका वस्त्र हों; दत्तात्रेयका नाम, यहाँ दत्तरूप साईं बाबाका
digambara.en: 'clad in the sky', naked; a name of Dattātreya, here of Sāī Bābā as Datta

discernment.en: the power to tell right from wrong, and the real from the unreal

discus.en: a sharp-edged wheel thrown as a weapon, as Viṣṇu's

dispassion.en: freedom from desire for the things of the world

diti.en: Diti, mother of the daityas (demons), sister of Aditi

drumstick.en: a stick for beating a drum

duality.hi: द्वैत, भेद-बुद्धि, वस्तुओंको अपनेसे अलग देखना
duality.en: seeing things as two, as other than oneself (dvaita)

durgā.hi: दुर्गा देवी, जो राक्षसोंका नाश करती हैं
durgā.en: Durgā, the Goddess in her fierce form, who destroys the demons

durmukha.en: Durmukha ("ugly-faced"), a demon warrior of Rāvaṇa

durvāsā.hi: दुर्वासा, अपने क्रोध और शापके लिये प्रसिद्ध मुनि
durvāsā.en: Durvāsā, a sage known for his quick anger and his curses

dvivida.hi: द्विविद, श्रीरामकी सेनाका बलवान् वानर योद्धा, मैन्दका भाई
dvivida.en: Dvivida, a mighty monkey warrior in Śrī Rāma's army, brother of Mainda

dvāpara.en: the Dvāpara age, the third of the four ages

dāmodara.hi: दामोदर, श्रीकृष्णका नाम (जिन्हें यशोदाने रस्सीसे बाँधा)
dāmodara.en: Dāmodara ("rope round the waist"), a name of Kṛṣṇa, whom Yaśodā bound with a rope

dānava.en: a dānava, one of a race of demons, foes of the gods

dīkṣā.hi: दीक्षा, यज्ञ या व्रतके लिये संस्कार
dīkṣā.en: consecration, initiation for a sacrifice or a vow

dūrvā.hi: दूब घास, पूजामें काम आनेवाली पवित्र घास
dūrvā.en: dūrvā grass, a holy grass used in worship

dūṣaṇa.hi: दूषण, एक बलवान् राक्षस, जो खरके साथ वनमें श्रीरामसे लड़ने आया और मारा गया
dūṣaṇa.en: Dūṣaṇa, a mighty demon who, with Khara, came against Śrī Rāma in the forest and was slain

eddy.en: water whirling round in a circle, against the current

enjoin.en: to order, to lay down as a duty

enjoyer.en: one who enjoys, who tastes pleasure and pain (bhoktā)

envoy.en: a messenger sent on another's behalf

extolling.hi: बहुत प्रशंसा करते हुए, सराहते हुए

fetter.en: a chain on the feet; a bond

forlorn.en: lonely, helpless and full of sorrow

gada.hi: गद, श्रीरामकी सेनाका एक वानर वीर
gada.en: Gada, a monkey warrior of Śrī Rāma's army

gandharva.en: a gandharva, one of the heavenly singers and musicians

garb.en: dress, clothing of a particular kind

garuḍa.hi: गरुड़, पक्षियोंके राजा, भगवान् विष्णुके वाहन और सर्पोंके शत्रु; मानसमें काकभुशुण्डिजीसे रामकथा सुननेवाले
garuḍa.en: Garuḍa, king of the birds, Viṣṇu's mount and the foe of serpents; in the Mānas he hears Rāma's story from Kākabhuśuṇḍi

gauri.hi: गउड़ी (गौड़ी), गुरु ग्रन्थ साहिबका एक राग
gauri.en: Gauri, a rāga (musical measure) of the Guru Granth Sahib

gaurī.en: Gaurī ("the fair one"), Pārvatī, the wife of Śiva

gayā.en: Gayā, a holy city in Magadha (Bihār), a place of pilgrimage

gaṅgāsāgara.hi: गंगासागर, जहाँ गंगा समुद्रमें मिलती है; एक तीर्थ
gaṅgāsāgara.en: Gaṅgāsāgara, where the Gaṅgā enters the sea, a place of pilgrimage

gaṇa.en: a host, a troop; Śiva's attendants

gaṇapati.en: Gaṇapati, lord of the hosts; Gaṇeśa

gaṇeśa.hi: गणेश, हाथीके मुखवाले देवता, शिव-पार्वतीके पुत्र, शिवगणोंके स्वामी और विघ्न हरनेवाले
gaṇeśa.en: Gaṇeśa, the elephant-headed god, son of Śiva and Pārvatī, lord of Śiva's hosts and remover of obstacles

gaṇu.hi: गणु, दासगणु, इस अभंगके कवि, साईं बाबाके भक्त
gaṇu.en: Gaṇu, Dāsagaṇu, the poet of this abhaṅga, a devotee of Sāī Bābā

ghat.hi: घाट, नदी या तालाबमें उतरनेकी सीढ़ियाँ
ghat.en: steps leading down to a river or lake, for bathing or drawing water

ghee.en: butter melted and cleared, used in food and offered into the sacred fire

ghoul.en: an evil spirit that feeds on the dead

ghāṭ.hi: घाट, नदी या तालाबमें उतरनेकी सीढ़ियाँ
ghāṭ.en: steps leading down to a river or lake, for bathing or drawing water

giani.en: one who has true knowledge; a Brahm Giani is one who knows God

gird.en: to tie a belt or cloth firmly round (the waist), to get ready

girdle.en: to encircle, to surround like a belt

girijā.hi: गिरिजा, पर्वतराजकी पुत्री पार्वतीजी, जिन्हें शिवजी मानसकी कथा सुनाते हैं
girijā.en: Girijā, Pārvatī, daughter of the mountain king, to whom Śiva tells the Mānas

giriśanta.hi: गिरिशन्त, रुद्रका नाम: पर्वतपर रहकर सुख देनेवाले
giriśanta.en: Giriśanta, a name of Rudra: he who dwells on the mountain and gives peace

gnash.en: to grind or snap the teeth

goad.en: a pointed stick for driving cattle or an elephant

godāvarī.hi: गोदावरी नदी, जिसके तटपर पंचवटी थी
godāvarī.en: the Godāvarī, a great river of the south, by which lay Pañcavaṭī

gomatī.hi: गोमती नदी, कोसल देशकी एक नदी
gomatī.en: the Gomatī, a river of the Kosala country

gopāla.en: a cowherd; Gopāla, a name of Kṛṣṇa

gopī.en: a gopī, a cowherd woman of Vraja, devoted to Kṛṣṇa

gorocana.hi: गोरोचन, गायसे मिलनेवाला चमकीला पीला पदार्थ, जिससे तिलक लगाते हैं
gorocana.en: gorocana, a bright yellow pigment from cattle, used for the tilak

gout.en: a painful disease of the joints

govinda.hi: गोविन्द, श्रीकृष्ण (विष्णु)का नाम; मानसमें श्रीरामका भी
govinda.en: Govinda, a name of Kṛṣṇa (Viṣṇu); in the Mānas, also of Śrī Rāma

guha.hi: गुह, शृंगवेरपुरके निषादराज, श्रीरामके प्रेमी सखा, जिन्होंने वनके मार्गमें उनकी सेवा की
guha.en: Guha, the Niṣāda chief of Śṛṅgaverapura, Śrī Rāma's loving friend, who served him on his way to the forest

guinea.hi: नहरुआ (नारू), त्वचाके नीचे रहनेवाला लंबा कीड़ा, जो पीड़ादायक फोड़ा करता है
guinea.en: guinea-worm: a long worm that lives under the skin and causes painful sores

guru.hi: गुरु, शिक्षक; ईश्वर और सत्यकी राह दिखानेवाले आचार्य
guru.en: a teacher; a spiritual guide who leads one to God and the truth

guñjā.hi: गुंजा (घुँघची), एक लताका छोटा लाल-काला बीज, जो सबसे छोटे तौलके काम आता है
guñjā.en: guñjā, the small red-and-black seed of a creeper, used as the least of weights

guṇa.hi: गुण, प्रकृतिके तीन गुण: सत्त्व, रज और तम
guṇa.en: the three qualities of nature, sattva (goodness), rajas (passion) and tamas (dullness), of which all things are made

gītā.en: the Bhagavad Gītā, Śrī Kṛṣṇa's teaching to Arjuna

hara.hi: हर, शिवजीका नाम: (पाप और दुःख) हरनेवाले
hara.en: Hara, a name of Śiva: he who takes away (sin and sorrow)

hari.hi: हरि, भगवान् विष्णुका नाम; मानसमें श्रीराम भी
hari.en: Hari, a name of Viṣṇu; in the Mānas also Śrī Rāma, who is Viṣṇu

hariścandra.hi: हरिश्चन्द्र, सत्यपर अटल राजा, जिन्होंने उसके लिये राज्य, पत्नी और पुत्र तक त्याग दिये
hariścandra.en: Hariścandra, the king who held to truth and gave up his kingdom, his wife and his son for it

hariḥ.hi: हरि, भगवान्: 'हरिः ॐ', पाठके आरम्भ या अन्तमें बोला जाता है
hariḥ.en: Hari, the Lord: 'Hariḥ Om', spoken at the start or close of a recitation

haumai.en: haumai, ego, the sense of "I" and "mine"

hemp.hi: सन, जिसके रेशोंसे रस्सी बनती है
hemp.en: a plant whose fibres, stripped from its stalk, are made into rope

hermitage.en: the dwelling of a sage or hermit in the forest

himālaya.hi: हिमालय, उत्तरका बड़ा हिमसे ढका पर्वत
himālaya.en: the Himālaya, the great snowy mountains of the north

hiraṇyagarbha.en: Hiraṇyagarbha, 'the golden womb': the first-born creator (Brahmā), from whom all comes

hiraṇyākṣa.hi: हिरण्याक्ष, हिरण्यकशिपुका भाई दैत्य, जो पृथ्वीको रसातल ले गया; वराहरूप विष्णुने उसे मारा
hiraṇyākṣa.en: Hiraṇyākṣa, a demon, brother of Hiraṇyakaśipu, who carried the earth down into the depths; Viṣṇu as the Boar slew him

homage.en: respect shown openly, by bowing or praise

horde.en: a large, wild crowd or band

indirā.en: Indirā, Lakṣmī, the wife of Viṣṇu

indra.hi: इन्द्र, देवताओंके राजा, स्वर्गके स्वामी, वज्रधारी
indra.en: Indra, king of the gods and lord of heaven, who wields the thunderbolt

indrajit.hi: इन्द्रजित्, 'इन्द्रको जीतनेवाला', मेघनाद, रावणका पुत्र; लक्ष्मणजीने उसे मारा
indrajit.en: Indrajit, 'conqueror of Indra', Meghanāda, Rāvaṇa's son; Lakṣmaṇa slew him

invoke.en: to call upon (a god) for help or presence

jamadagni.en: Jamadagni, a sage, the father of Paraśurāma

janaka.hi: जनक, मिथिला (विदेह) के राजा, सीताजीके पिता, ज्ञानी और विरक्त
janaka.en: Janaka, king of Mithilā (Videha), Sītā's father, wise and detached

japa.hi: जप, भगवान्का नाम या मन्त्र बार-बार दोहराना
japa.en: repeating a holy name or mantra again and again in worship

javāsa.hi: जवासा, एक कँटीला पौधा जो वर्षामें सूख जाता है
javāsa.en: javāsa, a thorny shrub that loses its leaves in the rains

jayanta.hi: जयन्त, इन्द्रका पुत्र, जिसने कौआ बनकर सीताजीके पैरमें चोंच मारी और श्रीरामके बाणसे भागता फिरा
jayanta.en: Jayanta, son of Indra, who as a crow pecked Sītā's foot and fled from Śrī Rāma's arrow

jaṭāyu.hi: जटायु, गीधराज, जिन्होंने सीताजीको बचानेके लिये रावणसे युद्ध किया और श्रीरामके सामने प्राण छोड़े
jaṭāyu.en: Jaṭāyu, the king of the vultures, who fought Rāvaṇa to save Sītā and gave up his life before Śrī Rāma

jujube.hi: बेर, एक छोटा गोल फल; 'हाथमें रखा बेर', जो पूरा और साफ दिखे
jujube.en: the jujube berry (ber), a small round fruit; 'a jujube in the hand', a thing seen wholly and plainly

jāmbavān.hi: जाम्बवान्, श्रीरामकी सेनामें रीछोंके बूढ़े और बुद्धिमान् राजा
jāmbavān.en: Jāmbavān, the old and wise king of the bears in Śrī Rāma's army

jānakī.en: Jānakī, Sītā, daughter of King Janaka

jātavedas.en: Jātavedas, fire, Agni, "who knows all that is born"

jīva.en: the individual soul, the living being

kabandha.hi: कबन्ध, बिना सिरका राक्षस (सिर धड़में था), जो दुर्वासा मुनिके शापसे राक्षस बना; श्रीरामने उसे मारकर उसका उद्धार किया
kabandha.en: Kabandha, a headless demon (his head was in his trunk), made a demon by the sage Durvāsā's curse; Śrī Rāma slew and freed him

kadrū.hi: कद्रू, कश्यपकी पत्नी, सर्पोंकी माता; उसने छलसे अपनी सौत विनताको दासी बनाया
kadrū.en: Kadrū, a wife of Kaśyapa and mother of the serpents; by a trick she made her co-wife Vinatā her slave

kaikeyī.hi: कैकेयी, राजा दशरथकी रानी, भरतकी माता, जिन्होंने श्रीरामको वन भिजवाया
kaikeyī.en: Kaikeyī, a queen of King Daśaratha and Bharata's mother, who had Śrī Rāma sent to the forest

kailāsa.hi: कैलास, हिमालयका पर्वत, जहाँ शिवजी रहते हैं
kailāsa.en: Kailāsa, the mountain in the Himālaya where Śiva dwells

kaivalya.en: kaivalya, final liberation, the soul's oneness, free of all else

kaiṭabha.hi: कैटभ, एक दैत्य, जिसे मधुके साथ विष्णुने मारा
kaiṭabha.en: Kaiṭabha, a demon whom Viṣṇu slew together with Madhu

kalaśa.hi: कलश, घड़ा; द्रोणकलश, सोमका बड़ा काठका पात्र
kalaśa.en: a pitcher, a water-pot; in droṇa-kalaśa, the large wooden vessel for the soma

kali.hi: कलियुग, चार युगोंमें चौथा और सबसे मलिन युग
kali.en: the Kali age, the fourth and darkest of the four ages

kalpa.hi: कल्प, सृष्टिका एक बहुत लम्बा युग: ब्रह्माजीका एक दिन, चारों युगोंके हजार फेरे
kalpa.en: a kalpa, an age of the world: a day of Brahmā, a thousand rounds of the four yugas

karma.en: action, work; also its fruit, which binds the one who acts
karma.hi: कर्म; और उसका फल, जो करनेवालेको बाँधता है

karmanāśā.hi: कर्मनाशा नदी, जिसके जलका स्पर्श पुण्यका नाश करनेवाला माना जाता है
karmanāśā.en: the Karmanāśā ("destroyer of merit"), a river whose water is held to wipe out the merit of whoever touches it

karīla.hi: करील, रेगिस्तानकी बिना पत्तोंकी कँटीली झाड़ी
karīla.en: karīla, a leafless thorny shrub of the desert

kausalyā.hi: कौसल्या, राजा दशरथकी बड़ी रानी, श्रीरामकी माता
kausalyā.en: Kausalyā, King Daśaratha's chief queen, Śrī Rāma's mother

kaṁsa.hi: कंस, मथुराका दुष्ट राजा, श्रीकृष्णका मामा, जिसे उन्होंने मारा
kaṁsa.en: Kaṁsa, the wicked king of Mathurā, Kṛṣṇa's uncle, slain by Kṛṣṇa

kekaya.hi: केकय, उत्तर-पश्चिमका एक देश, और उसका राजा, कैकेयीके पिता
kekaya.en: Kekaya, a kingdom of the north-west, and its king, Kaikeyī's father

kesarī.en: Kesarī, a monkey chief, the father of Hanumān

kettledrum.en: a large drum shaped like a bowl, beaten in war and at festivals

ketu.hi: केतु, अशुभ छाया-ग्रह, अपशकुनका चिह्न; पुच्छल तारा भी
ketu.en: Ketu, the baleful 'shadow planet', a sign of ill omen; also a comet

keśava.en: Keśava, a name of Viṣṇu and Kṛṣṇa

khara.hi: खर, एक बलवान् राक्षस, जो दूषणके साथ वनमें श्रीरामसे लड़ने आया और सेनासहित मारा गया
khara.en: Khara, a mighty demon who, with Dūṣaṇa, came against Śrī Rāma in the forest and was slain with his army

khasa.en: the Khasas, a people of the north

kinnara.hi: किन्नर, स्वर्गके गायक, जिनका रूप आधा मनुष्य आधा घोड़े-जैसा माना जाता है
kinnara.en: a kinnara, one of the heavenly singers, part man and part horse in form

kirāta.hi: किरात, वनों और पहाड़ोंमें शिकार करके रहनेवाली एक जाति
kirāta.en: the Kirātas, a hunting people of the forests and hills

kolhāpur.hi: कोल्हापुर, महाराष्ट्रका एक नगर, जहाँ दत्त भिक्षा माँगते हैं
kolhāpur.en: Kolhāpur, a city in Mahārāṣṭra, where Datta begs alms

kosala.hi: कोसल, राजा दशरथ और श्रीरामका राज्य, जिसकी राजधानी अयोध्या है
kosala.en: Kosala, the kingdom of Daśaratha and Śrī Rāma, with Ayodhyā as its capital

kosalapura.en: Kosalapura, the capital of Kosala, Ayodhyā

kośala.hi: कोसल देश, जिसकी राजधानी अयोध्या है
kośala.en: Kośala, the kingdom whose capital is Ayodhyā

kubera.en: Kubera, the god of wealth, lord of the Yakṣas

kumbhakarṇa.hi: कुम्भकर्ण, रावणका विशालकाय भाई, जो महीनों सोता था; श्रीरामने उसे मारा
kumbhakarṇa.en: Kumbhakarṇa, Rāvaṇa's giant brother, who slept for months at a time; slain by Śrī Rāma

kumāra.hi: कुमार, राजकुमार, पुत्र; अक्षयकुमार नामका अंश
kumāra.en: a prince, a young son; part of the name Akṣaya Kumāra

kuśa.hi: कुश, पूजा और आसनमें काम आनेवाली नुकीली पवित्र घास / कुश, सीताजी और श्रीरामके पुत्र, लवके भाई
kuśa.en: kuśa, a sacred grass with long, sharp blades, used in worship and for mats / Kuśa, one of the two sons of Sītā and Śrī Rāma, with Lava

kākabhuśuṇḍi.hi: काकभुशुण्डि, श्रीरामके परम भक्त कौआ, जिन्होंने गरुड़जीको रामकथा सुनायी
kākabhuśuṇḍi.en: Kākabhuśuṇḍi, a crow and great devotee of Śrī Rāma, who told Rāma's story to Garuḍa

kāla.hi: काल, समय, जो सबको खा जाता है; मृत्यु
kāla.en: Kāla, Time, who devours all; Death

kālabhairava.hi: कालभैरव, शिवजीका एक उग्र रूप, काशीके रक्षक
kālabhairava.en: Kālabhairava, a fierce form of Śiva, the guardian of Kāśī

kālanemi.hi: कालनेमि, एक राक्षस, जिसे रावणने ओषधि लाने जाते हनुमान्‌जीको रोकनेके लिये भेजा; वह मुनि बनकर बैठा
kālanemi.en: Kālanemi, a demon whom Rāvaṇa sent to stop Hanumān on his way to fetch the herb; he posed as a sage

kāliya.hi: कालिय नाग, यमुनाका सर्प, जिसे श्रीकृष्णने वशमें किया
kāliya.en: Kāliya, the serpent of the Yamunā whom Kṛṣṇa subdued

kāma.hi: काम, कामदेव, प्रेम और कामनाके देवता, रतिके पति, जिन्हें शिवजीने भस्म किया
kāma.en: Kāma, the god of love and desire (Kāmadeva), husband of Rati, whom Śiva burnt to ashes

kāmadeva.hi: कामदेव, प्रेमके देवता, जो अपनी सुन्दरताके लिये प्रसिद्ध हैं
kāmadeva.en: Kāmadeva, the god of love, famed for his beauty

kāśī.hi: काशी (वाराणसी), शिवजीकी पवित्र नगरी, जहाँ मरनेसे मुक्ति मिलती है
kāśī.en: Kāśī (Vārāṇasī), Śiva's holy city, where death brings liberation

kāṇḍa.en: a section or book of a text

kṛta.hi: कृतयुग (सत्ययुग), चार युगोंमें पहला और सबसे पवित्र
kṛta.en: the Kṛta (Satya) age, the first and purest of the four ages

kṣatriya.hi: क्षत्रिय, योद्धा और शासन करनेवाला वर्ण
kṣatriya.en: a kṣatriya, one of the warrior and ruling varṇa

lakṣmī.hi: लक्ष्मी, धन और सौभाग्यकी देवी, भगवान् विष्णुकी पत्नी
lakṣmī.en: Lakṣmī, the goddess of fortune and wealth, wife of Viṣṇu

lampblack.hi: काजल, दीयेकी कालिख; 'काजलका पर्वत', बहुत काली वस्तु
lampblack.en: black soot from a lamp's flame (kājal); 'a mountain of lampblack', something very black

laṅkinī.hi: लंकिनी, लंकाकी रक्षक राक्षसी, जिसे हनुमान्‌जीने मुक्केसे गिराया
laṅkinī.en: Laṅkinī, the demoness who guarded Laṅkā, struck down by Hanumān

libation.hi: तर्पण या आहुति, देवताओं या पितरोंको अर्पित जल, तिलाञ्जलि या घी
libation.en: a liquid (water, sesame-water, ghee) poured out as an offering to the gods or the departed

litter.en: a covered seat carried on poles, a palanquin

lomaśa.hi: लोमश ऋषि, जिन्होंने काकभुशुण्डिको कौआ होनेका शाप दिया और फिर रामभक्ति दी
lomaśa.en: Lomaśa, a long-lived sage who cursed Kākabhuśuṇḍi to become a crow, then taught him the worship of Śrī Rāma

līlā.en: divine play; the Lord's acts done as play

mace.en: a heavy club used as a weapon

madhu.hi: मधु, वसन्त ऋतु, कामदेवका साथी / मधु, एक दैत्य, जिसे कैटभके साथ विष्णुने मारा
madhu.en: Madhu, the spring season, Kāma's companion / Madhu, a demon whom Viṣṇu slew together with Kaiṭabha

madhuvana.hi: मधुवन, सुग्रीवका मधु और फलोंवाला बगीचा, जहाँ लौटते वानरोंने फल खाये
madhuvana.en: Madhuvana, Sugrīva's grove of honey and fruit, where the monkeys feasted on their return

maghā.hi: मघा नक्षत्र, जिसमें भारी वर्षा होती है
maghā.en: Maghā, the tenth lunar mansion; the rains under it are heavy

mahokha.en: the mahokha, a kind of bird

mahārāja.hi: महाराज, बड़ा राजा; संतके लिये आदरकी उपाधि भी, जैसे साईं बाबाके लिये
mahārāja.en: great king; also a title of honour for a saint, as for Sāī Bābā

mainda.hi: मैन्द, श्रीरामकी सेनाका एक वानर वीर, द्विविदका भाई
mainda.en: Mainda, a monkey warrior of Śrī Rāma's army, brother of Dvivida

maināka.hi: मैनाक, पंखवाला पर्वत, हिमालयका पुत्र, जो समुद्रमें छिपा रहा और हनुमान्‌जीको विश्राम देनेके लिये ऊपर उठा
maināka.en: Maināka, a winged mountain, son of Himālaya, who hid in the ocean and rose to give Hanumān rest

malign.en: evil, harmful / to speak ill of

mandara.hi: मन्दराचल, वह पर्वत जिससे देवताओं और दैत्योंने समुद्र मथा
mandara.en: Mandara, the mountain with which the gods and demons churned the ocean

mandodarī.hi: मन्दोदरी, रावणकी पटरानी, मयकी पुत्री, जिसने उसे बार-बार सीताजीको लौटानेकी सीख दी
mandodarī.en: Mandodarī, Rāvaṇa's chief queen, daughter of Maya, who often counselled him to give Sītā back

mandākinī.hi: मन्दाकिनी नदी, जो चित्रकूटमें बहती है
mandākinī.en: the Mandākinī, the river at Citrakūṭa

mantharā.hi: मन्थरा, कैकेयीकी कुबड़ी दासी, जिसने उसे श्रीरामके राजतिलकके विरुद्ध भड़काया
mantharā.en: Mantharā, Kaikeyī's hunchbacked maid, who turned her against Śrī Rāma's anointing

mantra.en: a sacred word or verse, repeated in worship or spoken to give power (as to an arrow)

manu.hi: मनु, मनुष्योंके आदिपिता और पहले धर्म-विधान देनेवाले; हर युग-चक्रका अपना मनु होता है
manu.en: Manu, father of mankind and first giver of law; each age of the world has its own Manu

marut.en: the Maruts, the storm gods, companions of Indra

marutta.hi: मरुत्त, अविक्षित्‌के पुत्र, एक प्राचीन राजा, जिनके यज्ञमें मरुद्‌गण परोसनेवाले बने
marutta.en: Marutta, an ancient king, son of Avikṣit, at whose sacrifice the Maruts served

maya.hi: माया, संसारका भ्रम और लुभावा / मय, दानवोंका शिल्पी, मन्दोदरीके पिता
maya.en: Maya (māyā), the world's illusion and lure / Maya, the demon builder, father of Mandodarī

mayaskara.en: Mayaskara, the giver of joy, a name of Śiva

mayobhu.en: Mayobhu, the source of joy, a name of Śiva

meghanāda.hi: मेघनाद, रावणका पुत्र, इन्द्रजित्, जिसे लक्ष्मणजीने मारा
meghanāda.en: Meghanāda, Rāvaṇa's son, also called Indrajit, slain by Lakṣmaṇa

meru.hi: सुमेरु, संसारके मध्यमें स्थित सोनेका पर्वत
meru.en: Meru, the golden mountain at the centre of the world

mithilā.hi: मिथिला, राजा जनककी नगरी, विदेहकी राजधानी
mithilā.en: Mithilā, King Janaka's city, the capital of Videha

mitra.hi: मित्र, मैत्री और वचन-पालनके वैदिक देवता, वरुणके साथी
mitra.en: Mitra, the Vedic god of friendship and of the pact kept, joined with Varuṇa

mohinīrāja.hi: मोहिनीराज, इस नमस्काराष्टकके कवि, जो अन्तिम पदमें अपना नाम लेते हैं
mohinīrāja.en: Mohinīrāja, the poet of this Namaskārāṣṭaka, who names himself in its last verse

mukunda.en: Mukunda, a name of Viṣṇu, here of Śrī Rāma

musk.en: a strong-smelling perfume from the musk deer

muskrat.en: the musk-shrew (chuchundar), a small animal with a strong smell

muñja.hi: मूँज, एक ऊँची घास, जिससे पवित्र मेखला और जनेऊ बनते हैं
muñja.en: muñja, a tall reed grass, from which the sacred girdle and thread are made

myna.en: the myna, a talking bird of the starling family

mādhava.hi: माधव, विष्णु (श्रीकृष्ण)का नाम / साईं आरतीमें कवि माधव, जो अपना नाम लेता है
mādhava.en: Mādhava, a name of Viṣṇu (Kṛṣṇa) / in the Sāī āratī, the poet Mādhava naming himself

māhur.hi: माहुर, महाराष्ट्रका एक तीर्थ, जहाँ दत्त शयन करते हैं
māhur.en: Māhur, a holy place in Mahārāṣṭra, where Datta sleeps

mālyavān.hi: माल्यवान्, बहुत बूढ़ा राक्षस, रावणका नाना और बुद्धिमान् मन्त्री
mālyavān.en: Mālyavān, a very old demon, Rāvaṇa's mother's father and his wise minister

mānasa.en: the Mānasa lake (Mānasarovara) in the Himālaya, home of the swans

mārīca.hi: मारीच, वह राक्षस जो रावणके कहनेपर सोनेका मृग बनकर श्रीरामको दूर ले गया और उनके हाथों मारा गया
mārīca.en: Mārīca, a demon who, at Rāvaṇa's bidding, took the form of a golden deer to draw Śrī Rāma away; slain by him

mārū.en: the Mārū, a martial musical mode played in battle

mātariśvā.en: Mātariśvā, the wind; the life-breath of the cosmos

māyā.hi: माया, भगवान्की वह शक्ति जो जगत्को रचती और सत्यको ढक देती है; भ्रम। मानसमें सीताजी भगवान्की माया हैं
māyā.en: the Lord's power that makes the world appear and hides the truth; illusion. In the Mānas, Sītā is the Lord's māyā

māṇḍūkya.en: the Māṇḍūkya Upaniṣad, of the Atharvaveda

naam.hi: नाम, प्रभुका नाम, जिसके स्मरणसे प्रभु पास जान पड़ते हैं
naam.en: the Naam, God's Name, God's presence remembered

naciketa.hi: नाचिकेत, नचिकेताके नामसे; नाचिकेत अग्नि, यमराजका नचिकेताको सिखाया अग्नि-यज्ञ
naciketa.en: of Naciketā: the Naciketa fire is the fire-rite Yama taught him, named after him

naciketā.hi: नचिकेता, वह बालक जो यमराजके पास गया और उनसे आत्मज्ञान पाया
naciketā.en: Naciketā, the boy who went to Yama, the god of death, and learnt from him the knowledge of the Self

nahuṣa.hi: नहुष, एक राजा जो इन्द्र बने; घमण्डमें ब्राह्मणोंसे पालकी उठवायी और शापसे गिरे
nahuṣa.en: Nahuṣa, a king who became lord of the gods; in his pride he made Brahmins carry his litter, and fell by a curse

nala.hi: नल, श्रीरामकी सेनाके वानर, नीलके भाई, जिनके साथ उन्होंने लंकाका पुल बाँधा
nala.en: Nala, a monkey of Śrī Rāma's army, brother of Nīla, with whom he built the bridge to Laṅkā

nandī.hi: नन्दी, शिवजीका बैल और प्रमुख गण
nandī.en: Nandī, Śiva's bull and chief attendant

narasiṁha.hi: नरसिंह, भगवान् विष्णुका अवतार, जिन्होंने प्रह्लादकी रक्षाके लिये हिरण्यकशिपुको मारा
narasiṁha.en: Narasiṁha, the man-lion form of Viṣṇu, who slew Hiraṇyakaśipu to save Prahlāda

neem.en: the neem tree, with bitter leaves

neti.hi: 'ऐसा नहीं': नेति नेति, 'यह नहीं, यह नहीं', वेद हर सीमित वस्तुको नकारकर ब्रह्मको ऐसे बताते हैं
neti.en: 'not so': neti neti, 'not this, not this', the way the Vedas point to Brahman by denying every limited thing

nimi.hi: निमि, इक्ष्वाकुके पुत्र एक प्राचीन राजा, जिनसे जनकजीका (विदेहका) राजवंश चला
nimi.en: Nimi, an ancient king, son of Ikṣvāku, from whom Janaka's royal line of Videha comes

nirgun.en: without qualities: God as beyond all attributes

nirvāṇa.en: final release; liberation from all worldly existence

niyama.hi: नियम, योगके पालन: शौच, संतोष, तप, स्वाध्याय और ईश्वर-भक्ति
niyama.en: niyama, the observances of yoga: purity, contentment, austerity, study and devotion to God

niṣāda.hi: निषाद, शिकार और मछली पकड़कर जीनेवाली वनकी एक जाति; गुह उनके राजा थे
niṣāda.en: the Niṣādas, a forest people who live by hunting and fishing; Guha was their chief

noose.en: a loop of rope that tightens when pulled

nāga.en: the Nāgas, divine serpents who live in the underworld (Pātāla)

nāmadeva.hi: नामदेव, महाराष्ट्रके संत-कवि, पंढरपुरके विट्ठलके भक्त; यह आरती उन्हींकी है
nāmadeva.en: Nāmadeva (Nāmdev), a saint-poet of Maharashtra, devotee of Viṭṭhala of Pandharpur; this āratī bears his name

nāmā.hi: नामा, संत नामदेव, जो अभंगके अन्तमें अपना नाम कहते हैं
nāmā.en: Nāmā, the saint Nāmadeva (Nāmdev), naming himself at the end of his abhaṅga

nārada.hi: नारद, हरिका गुण गाते हुए लोकोंमें घूमनेवाले देवर्षि
nārada.en: Nārada, the divine sage who roams the worlds singing the praise of Hari

nārāyaṇa.en: Nārāyaṇa, a name of Viṣṇu, the Supreme Lord

nīla.hi: नील, श्रीरामकी सेनाके वानर-सेनापति, नलके भाई, जिनके साथ उन्होंने लंकाका पुल बाँधा
nīla.en: Nīla, a monkey chief of Śrī Rāma's army, brother of Nala, with whom he built the bridge to Laṅkā

nīranidhi.en: a name of the ocean ('store of water')

oblation.en: an offering to a god, as into the sacred fire

observance.en: a religious practice or rule kept faithfully, such as a fast or the daily rites

ochre.hi: गेरू, लाल या पीली मिट्टी, जो रंगके काम आती है
ochre.en: a red or yellow earth used as a colour (geru)

omen.en: a sign of what is to come, good or ill

osprey.en: a large bird that catches fish (the kurarī)

outcaste.hi: जातिसे बाहर माना गया मनुष्य, चाण्डाल
outcaste.en: one put outside the castes and held lowest of all

paddy.en: rice growing in the field, or rice still in its husk

padma.hi: पद्म, पुरानी भारतीय गिनतीमें एक बहुत बड़ी संख्या
padma.en: a padma, an immense number in the old Indian count

palāśa.en: the palāśa tree, the flame of the forest, with bright red flowers

pampā.hi: पम्पा, दक्षिणका एक सरोवर, जिसके पास श्रीरामजी हनुमान् और सुग्रीवसे मिले
pampā.en: Pampā, a lake in the south, near which Śrī Rāma met Hanumān and Sugrīva

pandharpur.hi: पंढरपुर, महाराष्ट्रमें चंद्रभागा नदीके तटपर विट्ठलका तीर्थ
pandharpur.en: Pandharpur, a holy town in Maharashtra on the Candrabhāgā river, the seat of Viṭṭhala

parasol.en: a large umbrella held over a king as a sign of royalty

paraśurāma.hi: परशुराम, फरसा धारण करनेवाले ब्राह्मण योद्धा, जमदग्नि मुनिके पुत्र, विष्णुके एक अवतार
paraśurāma.en: Paraśurāma, the axe-bearing brāhmaṇa warrior, son of the sage Jamadagni, one of Viṣṇu's incarnations

parijat.en: the Pārijāta, the wish-fulfilling tree of heaven

pañcavaṭī.hi: पंचवटी, दण्डक वनमें गोदावरीके तटका स्थान, जहाँ श्रीरामजी वनवासमें रहे और जहाँसे सीताजी हरी गयीं
pañcavaṭī.en: Pañcavaṭī, a place in the Daṇḍaka forest by the Godāvarī, where Śrī Rāma lived in exile and from where Sītā was carried off

paśupati.en: Paśupati, 'lord of creatures', a name of Rudra-Śiva

pilferer.en: a petty thief, one who steals small things

pipal.en: the pipal, the sacred fig tree, whose leaves tremble in the least breeze

plied.en: kept at, used one after another (from 'ply')

prahasta.hi: प्रहस्त, रावणका पुत्र, जिसने उसे सीताजीको लौटानेकी सलाह दी
prahasta.en: Prahasta, a son of Rāvaṇa, who counselled him to give back Sītā

prahlāda.hi: प्रह्लाद, दैत्यराज हिरण्यकशिपुके भक्त पुत्र, जिनके लिये भगवान् नृसिंह रूपमें प्रकट हुए
prahlāda.en: Prahlāda, the devoted son of the demon king Hiraṇyakaśipu, for whose sake the Lord appeared as Narasiṁha

prajāpati.en: Prajāpati, lord of creatures, the creator

pramatha.en: the pramathas, a class of spirits who attend on Śiva

prapāṭhaka.en: a lesson or chapter, a division of a Vedic text

pratiprasthāna.en: the pratiprasthāna, one of the soma cups (grahas) of the sacrifice

pravarṣaṇa.hi: प्रवर्षण, वह पर्वत जहाँ सुग्रीवके राजतिलकके बाद श्रीरामजी वर्षा ऋतुमें रहे
pravarṣaṇa.en: Pravarṣaṇa, the mountain where Śrī Rāma lived through the rains after Sugrīva was made king

prayāga.hi: प्रयाग, तीर्थराज, जहाँ गंगा और यमुना मिलती हैं
prayāga.en: Prayāga, king of holy places, where the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā meet; today Prayagraj

presser.en: one who presses something; an oil-presser presses oil from seeds

profligate.en: one given to vice and loose living

prāṇa.hi: प्राण, जीवनकी साँस; शरीरके प्राणोंमें, ऊपरकी ओर चलनेवाला प्राण
prāṇa.en: prāṇa, the breath of life; as one of the body's breaths, the breath that moves upward

pulastya.hi: पुलस्त्य, ब्रह्माजीके पुत्र मुनि, रावणके दादा
pulastya.en: Pulastya, a sage, son of Brahmā, grandfather of Rāvaṇa

purana.hi: पुराण, देवताओं, राजाओं और सृष्टिकी कथाओंके प्राचीन ग्रन्थ
purana.en: the Purāṇas, ancient books of the stories of gods, kings and creation

puruṣa.hi: पुरुष, परम पुरुष, आत्मा, जिससे परे कुछ नहीं
puruṣa.en: the Puruṣa, the supreme Person: the Self, beyond which there is nothing higher

purāri.en: Purāri, 'enemy of Tripura': Śiva, who destroyed the demons' triple city

purāṇa.hi: पुराण, सृष्टि, देवताओं, ऋषियों और राजाओंकी कथाएँ कहनेवाले प्राचीन धर्मग्रन्थ
purāṇa.en: the Purāṇas, old sacred books that tell of creation, the gods, sages and kings

puṇḍalika.hi: पुंडलिक, वह भक्त जिसके लिये विट्ठल पंढरपुर आये और ईंटपर खड़े हैं
puṇḍalika.en: Puṇḍalika, the devotee for whose sake Viṭṭhala came to Pandharpur and stands there on a brick

puṣpaka.hi: पुष्पक, कुबेरका विमान, जिसे रावणने छीन लिया था; श्रीरामजी उसीपर अयोध्या लौटे
puṣpaka.en: Puṣpaka, Kubera's flying chariot, taken by Rāvaṇa; Śrī Rāma rode it home to Ayodhyā

pākar.hi: पाकड़, बरगद और पीपल-जैसा एक पेड़
pākar.en: the pākar, a kind of fig tree

pātnīvata.hi: पात्नीवत, सोमयागका एक ग्रह (पात्र), पत्नियोंसहित अग्निके लिये
pātnīvata.en: the pātnīvata, a soma cup (graha) of the sacrifice, for Agni with the wives (of the gods)

pātāla.en: Pātāla, the netherworld, the regions below the earth

pāṭhīna.en: a kind of large fish (a sheat-fish)

pīpal.en: the pīpal, the sacred fig tree

pūṣan.en: Pūṣan, the Sun as nourisher of all

quiver.en: a case for carrying arrows / to tremble, to shake

raag.hi: राग, संगीतका वह ढाँचा जिसमें वाणी गायी जाती है
raag.en: a raga, a melodic mode of Indian music in which a hymn is sung

raghu.hi: रघु, सूर्यवंशके प्रतापी राजा, श्रीरामके पूर्वज; रघुवंशी
raghu.en: Raghu, a great king of the solar line, Śrī Rāma's forefather; the Raghus are his line, Rāma's family

raghupati.en: Raghupati, lord of the Raghus: Śrī Rāma

raghuvīra.en: Raghuvīra, the hero of the Raghus: Śrī Rāma

rajas.hi: रजोगुण, कामना और चंचल कर्मका गुण, तीन गुणोंमें एक
rajas.en: rajas, the quality of passion and restless action, one of the three guṇas

rakṣā.hi: रक्षा; रामरक्षा, श्रीरामसे रक्षा माँगनेवाला स्तोत्र
rakṣā.en: protection; the Rāma Rakṣā is the hymn that seeks Śrī Rāma's protection

rampart.en: a high defensive wall around a city or fort

ramā.hi: रमा, लक्ष्मीजी, भगवान् विष्णुकी पत्नी; रमापति, विष्णु (श्रीराम)
ramā.en: Ramā, Lakṣmī, the wife of Viṣṇu; the Lord of Ramā is Viṣṇu (Śrī Rāma)

rathantara.en: the rathantara, a famous chant (Sāman) of the Sāmaveda, paired with the bṛhat

rati.en: Rati, wife of Kāmadeva, the god of love; a model of beauty

raurava.hi: रौरव, एक नरक, भयंकर पीड़ाका स्थान
raurava.en: Raurava, one of the hells, a place of dreadful pain

raṅga.en: Raṅga, Śrī Raṅga: a name of the Lord Viṣṇu (Raṅganātha)

renounce.en: to give up, to let go of

renunciant.en: one who has given up the world

revile.en: to speak of with scorn and insult

riddhi.hi: ऋद्धि, समृद्धि, ऐश्वर्य; ऋद्धियाँ-सिद्धियाँ ऐश्वर्य और अलौकिक शक्तियाँ हैं
riddhi.en: prosperity, plenty; the Riddhis, with the Siddhis, are the powers of plenty and achievement

ringworm.en: a skin disease that makes itching round patches

rudra.hi: रुद्र, भगवान् शिवका उग्र रूप; रुद्रगण, उनके अनगिनत रूप
rudra.en: Rudra, Śiva in his fierce form, the god praised in the Rudram; the Rudras are his countless forms

rudrāṣṭaka.hi: रुद्राष्टक, शिवजी (रुद्र) की आठ श्लोकोंकी स्तुति, जो काकभुशुण्डिके गुरु ब्राह्मणने की
rudrāṣṭaka.en: the Rudrāṣṭaka, a hymn of eight verses to Rudra (Śiva), spoken by Kākabhuśuṇḍi's guru

rāghava.hi: राघव, रघुके वंशज; राघवोंमें श्रेष्ठ श्रीराम
rāghava.en: a descendant of Raghu; the best of the Rāghavas is Śrī Rāma

rāhu.hi: राहु, ग्रहणमें सूर्य-चन्द्रमाको ग्रसनेवाला दैत्य-ग्रह; अपशकुनका चिह्न
rāhu.en: Rāhu, the demon 'planet' said to swallow the sun and moon at an eclipse; a sign of ill omen

rāmabhadra.en: Rāmabhadra, 'Rāma the good, the auspicious', a name of Śrī Rāma

rāmacaritamānasa.hi: रामचरितमानस, 'श्रीरामके चरितका सरोवर': शिवजीकी रची श्रीरामकथा, जिसे तुलसीदासने इस ग्रन्थमें कहा
rāmacaritamānasa.en: the Rāmacaritamānasa, 'the lake of Rāma's deeds': the story of Śrī Rāma as Śiva composed it, which Tulasīdāsa tells in this poem

rāmalalā.en: Rāmalalā, Śrī Rāma as a little child

rāmeśvara.hi: रामेश्वर, सेतु बाँधते समय समुद्र-तटपर श्रीरामजीके स्थापित किये शिवलिंग
rāmeśvara.en: Rāmeśvara, the Śiva liṅga that Śrī Rāma set up on the seashore when the bridge to Laṅkā was built

rāmāyaṇa.en: the Rāmāyaṇa, the story of Śrī Rāma

rāsa.hi: रास, गोपियोंके साथ श्रीकृष्णका मण्डलाकार नृत्य
rāsa.en: the rāsa, the circle dance of Kṛṣṇa with the cowherd maidens (gopīs)

saadh.hi: साध, साधु, भगवान्के नाममें रहनेवाला संत; साधसंगत, संतोंकी संगति
saadh.en: a holy one, a saint who lives in God's Name; the Saadh Sangat is the company of the holy

saakat.en: a Saakat, one who has turned away from God

sabre.en: a heavy sword with a curved blade

saccidānanda.hi: सत्, चित् और आनन्द: परब्रह्मका स्वरूप
saccidānanda.en: being, consciousness and bliss: the nature of Brahman, the Supreme

sadguru.en: the true guru, the perfect spiritual master (said of Sāī Bābā)

sagara.hi: सगर, अयोध्याके राजा (श्रीरामके पूर्वज); कपिल मुनिके कोपसे भस्म हुए उनके साठ हजार पुत्रोंका गंगाजीने उद्धार किया
sagara.en: Sagara, a king of Ayodhyā of Śrī Rāma's line; his sixty thousand sons, burnt to ashes by the sage Kapila's wrath, were delivered by Gaṅgā

sahasrabāhu.hi: सहस्रबाहु, 'हजार भुजाओंवाला', राजा कार्तवीर्य अर्जुन, जिसने एक बार रावणको हराया; परशुरामने उसे मारा
sahasrabāhu.en: Sahasrabāhu, 'the thousand-armed', King Kārtavīrya Arjuna, who once defeated Rāvaṇa; Paraśurāma slew him

salutation.en: a bow or greeting of respect

sampāti.hi: सम्पाती, जटायुके भाई गीध, जिनके पंख सूर्यसे जल गये थे; उन्होंने वानरोंको सीताजीका पता बताया
sampāti.en: Sampāti, a vulture, Jaṭāyu's brother, whose wings were burnt by the sun; he told the monkeys where Sītā was

sanaka.hi: सनक, ब्रह्माजीके मनसे उत्पन्न, सदा बालरूप रहनेवाले चार मुनियोंमें पहले (सनक, सनन्दन, सनातन, सनत्कुमार)
sanaka.en: Sanaka, eldest of four sages born from Brahmā's mind who stay ever as children (Sanaka, Sanandana, Sanātana and Sanatkumāra)

sangat.hi: संगत, साथ, समाज; साध संगत, संतोंका साथ
sangat.en: company, a gathering; the Saadh Sangat, the company of the holy

sannipāta.hi: सन्निपात, वात, पित्त और कफ तीनोंके बिगड़नेसे होनेवाला भारी ज्वर
sannipāta.en: a grave fever in which all three humours of the body (wind, bile and phlegm) are disordered

sant.en: a saint, a holy person devoted to God

sarasvatī.en: Sarasvatī, the goddess of speech and learning

sarayū.hi: सरयू, पवित्र नदी, जिसके किनारे अयोध्या बसी है
sarayū.en: the Sarayū, the holy river on whose bank Ayodhyā stands

sargun.en: with qualities: God in manifest form

sattva.hi: सत्त्वगुण, तीन गुणोंमें शुद्धता और प्रकाशका गुण
sattva.en: sattva, the quality of goodness, purity and light, one of the three guṇas

satī.hi: सती, दक्षकी पुत्री और शिवजीकी पत्नी, जो फिर पार्वती होकर जन्मीं; शिवजी पार्वतीको इसी नामसे पुकारते हैं
satī.en: Satī, Dakṣa's daughter and Śiva's wife, born again as Pārvatī; Śiva calls Pārvatī by this name

savitṛ.hi: सविता, जगानेवाले और जीवन देनेवाले सूर्यदेव
savitṛ.en: Savitṛ, the Sun as the god who rouses and gives life

saṃhitā.en: the Saṃhitā, the collected mantras of a Veda

saṃsāra.en: the round of birth and death; worldly existence

scimitar.en: a sword with a curved blade

scruple.hi: संकोच, उचित-अनुचितका सोच; दूसरेका ध्यान रखकर झिझकना
scruple.en: a doubt or hesitation about what is right; holding back out of regard for others

seer.en: one who sees; a sage who sees the truth

shehnai.en: a reed pipe of north India, played at weddings and festivals

shirdi.hi: शिरडी, महाराष्ट्रका गाँव, जहाँ साईं बाबा रहे
shirdi.en: Shirdi, a village in Maharashtra where Sāī Bābā lived

siddha.hi: सिद्ध, सिद्धिप्राप्त योगी और देवयोनिके प्राणी
siddha.en: the Siddhas, perfected ones: semi-divine beings, and yogis who have gained spiritual powers

siddhi.hi: सिद्धि, योगसे प्राप्त अलौकिक शक्ति; सिद्धियाँ, सेवा करनेवाली देवियोंके रूपमें
siddhi.en: a supernatural power gained by yoga; the Siddhis, such powers as goddesses who serve

simran.hi: सिमरन, प्रेमसे भगवान्का स्मरण और नाम-जप
simran.en: remembering God with love, dwelling on and repeating His Name

simriti.en: the Smritis, the books of sacred law and tradition

sinew.en: a cord of the body that joins muscle to bone; a vein or a nerve

smṛti.hi: स्मृति, वेदके अतिरिक्त परम्परासे चले आये धर्मग्रन्थ
smṛti.en: sacred tradition, the texts remembered and handed down beside the Veda

snare.en: a trap; a noose for catching

so'ham.en: 'I am That': knowing oneself as one with Brahman

soma.hi: सोम, यज्ञमें अर्पित पवित्र लताका रस और उसके देवता / रुद्रमें, उमासहित शिव
soma.en: Soma, the sacred plant whose juice is offered in sacrifice, and its god / in the Rudram, Śiva as 'he who is with Umā'

stepwell.en: a well with steps going down to the water

stoma.hi: स्तोम, स्तुति; सोमयागमें सामगानका एक निश्चित क्रम
stoma.en: a hymn of praise; in the soma rite, a set form of chanting a Sāman

strait.hi: संकट, दुविधा, दो कर्तव्योंके बीच फँसना
strait.en: a tight spot, a hard choice between two duties

stratagem.en: a cunning plan to defeat an enemy

subāhu.hi: सुबाहु, ताड़काका पुत्र राक्षस, जिसने विश्वामित्रके यज्ञमें विघ्न डाला और श्रीरामजीके हाथों मारा गया
subāhu.en: Subāhu, a demon, Tāṛakā's son, who attacked Viśvāmitra's sacrifice and was slain by Śrī Rāma

sugrīva.hi: सुग्रीव, वानरराज, बालिके छोटे भाई, श्रीरामके मित्र
sugrīva.en: Sugrīva, the monkey king, Vāli's younger brother, who became Śrī Rāma's friend

sukhmani.hi: सुखमनी, 'सुखकी मणि': सुखमनी साहिब, पाँचवें गुरु, गुरु अर्जनदेवजीकी बाणी
sukhmani.en: Sukhmani, 'the jewel of peace': the Sukhmani Sahib, the bani of the Fifth Guru, Guru Arjan

sumantra.hi: सुमन्त्र, राजा दशरथके मन्त्री और सारथि, जो वन जाते श्रीरामको रथमें गंगातक ले गये
sumantra.en: Sumantra, King Daśaratha's minister and charioteer, who drove Śrī Rāma in his chariot as far as the Gaṅgā on his way to the forest

sumeru.hi: सुमेरु (मेरु), संसारके बीचमें स्थित सोनेका महान् पर्वत
sumeru.en: Sumeru (Meru), the great golden mountain at the centre of the world

sumitrā.hi: सुमित्रा, राजा दशरथकी रानी, लक्ष्मण और शत्रुघ्नकी माता
sumitrā.en: Sumitrā, a queen of King Daśaratha, mother of Lakṣmaṇa and Śatrughna

surasā.hi: सुरसा, सर्पोंकी माता, जिसे देवताओंने समुद्र पार करते हनुमान्‌की परीक्षाके लिये भेजा
surasā.en: Surasā, the mother of serpents, sent by the gods to test Hanumān as he crossed the ocean

sutīkṣṇa.hi: सुतीक्ष्ण, अगस्त्यजीके शिष्य मुनि, श्रीरामजीके प्रेमी भक्त
sutīkṣṇa.en: Sutīkṣṇa, a sage, Agastya's disciple, who loved Śrī Rāma dearly

suvela.hi: सुबेल, लंकाका एक पर्वत, जहाँ श्रीरामने सेनासहित डेरा डाला
suvela.en: Suvela, a mountain of Laṅkā, where Śrī Rāma camped with his army

suṣeṇa.hi: सुषेण, लंकाका वैद्य, जिसे हनुमान्‌जी लक्ष्मणजीके उपचारके लिये लाये
suṣeṇa.en: Suṣeṇa, a physician of Laṅkā, brought by Hanumān to heal Lakṣmaṇa

svagākāra.en: the svagākāra, the call 'svagā' uttered in the sacrifice

svaru.hi: स्वरु, यूप (यज्ञ-स्तम्भ) से काटा गया खण्ड
svaru.en: a chip cut from the sacrificial post

svāhā.hi: स्वाहा, अग्निमें आहुति डालते समय बोला जानेवाला शब्द
svāhā.en: svāhā, the call spoken as an offering is poured into the fire

svāmī.hi: स्वामी, मालिक; संतके नामके साथ आदरकी उपाधि
svāmī.en: master, lord; a title of honour for a holy man

swagger.en: to strut and show off, full of pride

swoon.en: a faint; to faint, to fall senseless

sādhya.en: the Sādhyas, a class of celestial beings, ancient gods

sāman.en: a Sāman, a verse set to a chant, of the Sāmaveda

sāttvika.en: of sattva: pure, good, full of light

sāīnātha.en: Sāīnātha, Lord Sāī: Sāī Bābā of Shirdi

taittirīya.en: of the Taittirīya school of the Kṛṣṇa (Black) Yajurveda

tamas.hi: तमोगुण, अंधकार, जड़ता और अज्ञानका गुण, तीन गुणोंमें एक
tamas.en: tamas, the quality of darkness, dullness and ignorance, one of the three guṇas

tamasā.hi: तमसा, अयोध्याके पासकी नदी, जहाँ वनवासकी पहली रात श्रीराम ठहरे
tamasā.en: the Tamasā, a river near Ayodhyā, where Śrī Rāma made the first night's halt of his exile

tamāla.en: the tamāla, a tree with very dark bark

tilak.en: a mark of sandal-paste or other colour on the forehead

tilaka.hi: राजतिलक, राज्याभिषेक / माथेपर लगाया जानेवाला तिलक
tilaka.en: the tilaka of kingship: the mark of anointing at a king's crowning, so the crowning itself / a mark on the forehead

tirhut.hi: तिरहुत, मिथिला देश, राजा जनकका राज्य
tirhut.en: Tirhut, the land of Mithilā, King Janaka's kingdom

tretā.hi: त्रेतायुग, चार युगोंमें दूसरा, जिसमें श्रीराम अवतरित हुए
tretā.en: the Tretā age, the second of the four ages, in which Śrī Rāma came

trijaṭā.hi: त्रिजटा, लंकाकी राक्षसी, जो श्रीरामकी भक्त थी और सीताजीको ढाढ़स देती थी
trijaṭā.en: Trijaṭā, a demoness in Laṅkā who guarded Sītā, loved Śrī Rāma and comforted her

trikūṭa.hi: त्रिकूट, तीन चोटियोंवाला पर्वत, जिसपर लंका बसी है
trikūṭa.en: Trikūṭa, the three-peaked mountain on which Laṅkā stands

tripura.hi: त्रिपुर, त्रिपुरासुर, जिसे शिवजीने मारा; त्रिपुरारि, शिवजी
tripura.en: Tripura, the demon of the three cities, whom Śiva destroyed; 'foe of Tripura' is Śiva

triveṇī.hi: त्रिवेणी, प्रयागमें गंगा, यमुना और सरस्वतीका संगम
triveṇī.en: the Triveṇī, the meeting at Prayāga of three rivers: the Gaṅgā, the Yamunā and the Sarasvatī

triśaṅku.hi: त्रिशंकु, अयोध्याके राजा, जो सशरीर स्वर्ग जाना चाहते थे; देवताओंने गिराया तो वे बीचमें ही लटके रह गये
triśaṅku.en: Triśaṅku, a king of Ayodhyā who sought to rise to heaven in his body; cast down by the gods, he hangs between heaven and earth

triśirā.hi: त्रिशिरा, तीन सिरोंवाला राक्षस, खर-दूषणका साथी, जिसे श्रीरामजीने मारा
triśirā.en: Triśirā, a three-headed demon who fought beside Khara and Dūṣaṇa and was slain by Śrī Rāma

tuber.en: a thick root, like a yam, eaten as food

tulasī.hi: तुलसी, पवित्र पौधा, विष्णु भगवान्‌को प्रिय
tulasī.en: the tulasī, the holy basil, dear to Viṣṇu

tulasīdāsa.hi: तुलसीदास, रामचरितमानस और श्रीरामके अन्य पदोंके रचयिता संत-कवि
tulasīdāsa.en: Tulasīdāsa, the poet-saint who wrote the Rāmacaritamānasa and other songs of Śrī Rāma

turīya.hi: तुरीय, जाग्रत्, स्वप्न और सुषुप्तिसे परे चौथी अवस्था
turīya.en: turīya, 'the fourth': pure consciousness, beyond waking, dream and deep sleep

tuṅgā.hi: तुंगा, दक्षिण भारत (कर्नाटक) की एक पवित्र नदी
tuṅgā.en: the Tuṅgā, a holy river of south India (in Karnataka)

tvaṣṭṛ.en: Tvaṣṭṛ, the divine craftsman, maker of forms

tāmasic.en: of tamas: dark, dull and heavy in nature

tāra.hi: तार, रुद्र (शिव) का नाम: भवसागरसे पार उतारनेवाले
tāra.en: Tāra, a name of Rudra (Śiva): the deliverer who carries beings across (the sea of worldly life)

tārkṣya.hi: तार्क्ष्य, वेदके एक दिव्य प्राणी, जिन्हें गरुड़ माना गया
tārkṣya.en: Tārkṣya, a divine being of the Veda, later known as Garuḍa, the eagle of Viṣṇu

tārā.en: Tārā, Vāli's wife, mother of Aṅgada

tāṛakā.hi: ताड़का, मारीच और सुबाहुकी माता राक्षसी, जिसे विश्वामित्रके कहनेपर श्रीरामजीने मारा
tāṛakā.en: Tāṛakā, a demoness, mother of Mārīca and Subāhu, slain by Śrī Rāma at Viśvāmitra's bidding

ujjain.hi: उज्जैन, मालवाकी प्राचीन नगरी, महाकाल शिवका तीर्थ
ujjain.en: Ujjain, an ancient city of Malwa, holy to Śiva as Mahākāla

unfathomable.hi: अथाह, जिसकी थाह या समझ न पायी जा सके
unfathomable.en: too deep to be measured or understood

unmanifest.en: not seen or shown; not yet given form

unstring.hi: धनुषकी डोरी उतारना, जिससे वह ढीला हो जाय
unstring.en: to take the string off a bow, so that it is slack

upaniṣad.hi: उपनिषद्, वेदोंके अन्तमें ब्रह्मका ज्ञान देनेवाले ग्रन्थ (वेदान्त)
upaniṣad.en: an Upaniṣad, one of the teachings on Brahman that close the Vedas (Vedānta)

upholder.en: one who supports and keeps up (dharma)

upāsanī.hi: उपासनी बाबा (उपासनी महाराज), साईं बाबाके शिष्य, जिन्होंने यह महिम्न स्तोत्र रचा
upāsanī.en: Upāsanī Bābā (Upāsanī Mahārāj), a disciple of Sāī Bābā, who wrote this Mahimna hymn

upāṃśu.en: the upāṃśu, one of the soma cups (grahas) of the sacrifice

vaidehī.en: Vaidehī, Sītā, the princess of Videha

vaikuṇṭha.en: Vaikuṇṭha, the heavenly abode of Viṣṇu

vaishnav.hi: वैष्णव, विष्णुका भक्त; गुरबाणीमें प्रभुका सच्चा भक्त
vaishnav.en: a Vaishnav, a devotee of Vishnu; in Gurbani, a true devotee of God

vaitaraṇī.en: the Vaitaraṇī, the dreadful river on the way to Yama's realm

vaivasvata.en: Vaivasvata, son of Vivasvat (the Sun): Yama

vaiśravaṇa.hi: वैश्रवण, विश्रवाके पुत्र कुबेर, धनके देवता
vaiśravaṇa.en: Vaiśravaṇa, Kubera, son of Viśravas, the god of wealth

vaiśvānara.en: Vaiśvānara, the fire common to all men (Agni)

vaiśya.hi: वैश्य, तीसरे वर्णका मनुष्य: व्यापारी, किसान, पशुपालक
vaiśya.en: a Vaiśya, one of the third varṇa: merchants, farmers and herdsmen

vajrapañjara.hi: वज्रपंजर, 'वज्रका पिंजरा', अटूट रक्षा: रामरक्षा-कवचका नाम
vajrapañjara.en: 'the adamantine cage', a sure refuge: the name of Rāma's armour in the Rāma-rakṣā

varuṇa.en: Varuṇa, the god of the waters and the ocean

varṇa.hi: वर्ण, समाजके चार वर्ण: ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, वैश्य और शूद्र
varṇa.en: one of the four classes of society: brāhmaṇa, kṣatriya, vaiśya and śūdra

vasiṣṭha.en: Vasiṣṭha, the sage who was the family guru of the Raghu kings

veda.hi: वेद, सबसे प्राचीन पवित्र शास्त्र (ऋग्, यजुः, साम और अथर्व)
veda.en: the Vedas, the oldest sacred scriptures (Ṛg, Yajur, Sāma and Atharva)

vedānta.en: Vedānta, 'the end of the Veda': the Upaniṣads and the teaching drawn from them

vetāla.en: a vetāla, a spirit or goblin that enters dead bodies

veṇīmādhava.en: Veṇīmādhava, Viṣṇu as the presiding deity of Prayāga

vibhīṣaṇa.hi: विभीषण, रावणके छोटे भाई, श्रीरामके भक्त, जिन्हें श्रीरामने लंकाका राजा बनाया
vibhīṣaṇa.en: Vibhīṣaṇa, Rāvaṇa's younger brother, a devotee of Śrī Rāma, who made him king of Laṅkā

videha.hi: विदेह, मिथिला राज्य; राजा विदेह अर्थात् जनकजी
videha.en: Videha, the kingdom of Mithilā; King Videha is Janaka

vikaṭāsya.en: Vikaṭāsya, one of the monkey chiefs in Śrī Rāma's army

vinatā.hi: विनता, गरुड़की माता, जिसे सौत कद्रूने छलसे दासी बनाया
vinatā.en: Vinatā, mother of Garuḍa, whom her co-wife Kadrū made a slave by a trick

vindhya.en: the Vindhya, a range of mountains across central India

virādha.hi: विराध, वनका राक्षस, जिसे श्रीरामने मारा
virādha.en: Virādha, a demon of the forest whom Śrī Rāma slew

viśvajit.hi: विश्वजित्, एक यज्ञ जिसमें यजमान अपना सब कुछ दान कर देता है
viśvajit.en: the Viśvajit ('all-conquering'), a sacrifice in which one gives away all one has

viśvedeva.hi: विश्वेदेव, साथ पूजे जानेवाले वैदिक देवताओंका एक गण
viśvedeva.en: the Viśvedevas, the 'All-gods', a group of Vedic gods worshipped together

viśvāmitra.hi: विश्वामित्र, राजासे ब्रह्मर्षि बने मुनि, जो राम-लक्ष्मणको अपने यज्ञकी रक्षाके लिये ले गये और जनकपुर ले आये
viśvāmitra.en: Viśvāmitra, the sage, born a king, who took Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa to guard his sacrifice and led them to Janaka's city

viṭṭhala.hi: विट्ठल (विठोबा), पंढरपुरमें पूजे जानेवाले भगवान् विष्णु (श्रीकृष्ण)
viṭṭhala.en: Viṭṭhala (Viṭhobā), the Lord Viṣṇu as Kṛṣṇa, worshipped at Pandharpur

vyāna.en: vyāna, the breath that pervades the whole body

vājapeya.en: the Vājapeya, one of the great soma sacrifices

vājaśravas.hi: वाजश्रवा, एक ऋषि; उनके पुत्र (नचिकेताके पिता) ने विश्वजित् यज्ञमें सब कुछ दान कर दिया
vājaśravas.en: Vājaśravas, a sage; his son, Naciketā's father, gave away all he had in the Viśvajit sacrifice

vāli.hi: बालि, किष्किन्धाके वानरराज, सुग्रीवके बड़े भाई, जिन्हें श्रीरामने मारा
vāli.en: Vāli, the monkey king of Kiṣkindhā, Sugrīva's elder brother, slain by Śrī Rāma

vālmīki.hi: वाल्मीकि, आदिकवि मुनि, रामायणके रचयिता, जिनके आश्रममें श्रीराम गये
vālmīki.en: Vālmīki, the sage and first poet, author of the Rāmāyaṇa, whose hermitage Śrī Rāma visited

vāmadeva.hi: वामदेव, अयोध्याके ऋषि, जो वसिष्ठजीके साथ राजा दशरथके कुलको सलाह देते थे
vāmadeva.en: Vāmadeva, a sage of Ayodhyā, who with Vasiṣṭha counselled King Daśaratha's house

vārīśa.en: a name of the ocean ('lord of waters')

vāsudeva.en: Vāsudeva, a name of Kṛṣṇa (Viṣṇu), son of Vasudeva

vāyu.en: Vāyu, the god of the wind

wagtail.en: a small bird that wags its tail (the khañjana), to which lovely restless eyes are likened

weevil.en: a tiny beetle that eats stored grain

woodworm.en: a grub that bores into wood and eats it away

yajurveda.en: the Yajurveda, the Veda of the formulas used in sacrifice

yajus.en: a Yajus, a sacrificial formula (in prose) of the Yajurveda

yakṣiṇī.en: a yakṣiṇī, a female yakṣa (a semi-divine being)

yama.en: Yama, the controller; also the god of death

yamunā.hi: यमुना, पवित्र नदी जो प्रयागमें गंगासे मिलती है
yamunā.en: the Yamunā, a holy river that joins the Gaṅgā at Prayāga

yavana.hi: यवन, विदेशी (पहले यूनानी), जो वर्णोंसे बाहर गिने जाते थे
yavana.en: a Yavana, a foreigner (first the Greeks), counted outside the varṇas

yoga.hi: योग, इन्द्रियों और मनको वशमें करके ईश्वर या आत्मासे जुड़नेकी साधना
yoga.en: the discipline of holding the senses and stilling the mind to reach God or the Self; spiritual practice

yoginī.hi: योगिनी, देवीकी सेवामें रहनेवाली भयंकर स्त्री-शक्ति, जो रणभूमिमें घूमती है
yoginī.en: a yoginī, a fierce female spirit attending the Goddess, haunting the battlefield

yogī.hi: योगी, योगका अभ्यास करनेवाला, जिसने मनको भगवान्‌में लगाया हो
yogī.en: a yogī, one who practises yoga and has joined his mind to God

yojana.en: a measure of long distance, four kos (often reckoned at about nine miles)

zenith.hi: ऊर्ध्व दिशा, ठीक सिरके ऊपरका आकाश
zenith.en: the point of the sky straight overhead; the upward direction

āditya.en: Āditya, the Sun; a son of Aditi, one of the gods

āgama.en: the Āgamas, sacred scriptures handed down by tradition

āgnīdhra.hi: आग्नीध्र, यज्ञमें अग्नि जलानेवाले ऋत्विज्‌का स्थान
āgnīdhra.en: the āgnīdhra, the place of the fire-kindling priest (āgnīdh) at the sacrifice

āgrayaṇa.en: the āgrayaṇa, one of the soma cups (grahas) of the sacrifice

ārati.hi: आरती, दीपक घुमाकर की जानेवाली पूजा या स्वागत
ārati.en: the waving of lamps before a deity or an honoured person, in worship or welcome

āratī.hi: आरती, दीपक घुमाकर की जानेवाली पूजा; उस समय गाया जानेवाला गीत
āratī.en: worship by waving lamps before a deity; also the song sung while doing it

āruṇi.hi: आरुणि (औद्दालकि), अरुणके वंशज; कठोपनिषद्में नचिकेताके पिता
āruṇi.en: Āruṇi (Auddālaki), son of Aruṇa's line; in the Kaṭha Upaniṣad, Naciketā's father

āśrama.hi: आश्रम, जीवनकी अवस्था (ब्रह्मचर्य, गृहस्थ, वानप्रस्थ, संन्यास)
āśrama.en: a stage of life (student, householder, forest-dweller, renunciant)

īśāna.en: Īśāna, 'the ruler': a name of Śiva

śabara.en: a Śabara, one of a wild forest tribe

śabarī.hi: शबरी, शबर (वनवासी) जातिकी भक्त स्त्री, जो अपने आश्रममें श्रीरामकी बाट जोहती रही; उन्होंने उसे परम गति दी
śabarī.en: Śabarī, a woman of the Śabara forest people, a devotee who waited for Śrī Rāma in her hermitage; he gave her the highest state

śakvarī.hi: शक्वरी, एक वैदिक छन्द; उस छन्दकी ऋचाएँ
śakvarī.en: śakvarī, a Vedic metre; the verses in it

śambhu.en: Śambhu, Śiva, the source of happiness

śarabhaṅga.hi: शरभंग, मुनि जिन्होंने श्रीरामजीके दर्शन करके योगाग्निमें शरीर त्याग दिया
śarabhaṅga.en: Śarabhaṅga, a sage who, after seeing Śrī Rāma, gave up his body in the fire of yoga

śarva.hi: शर्व, रुद्र (शिव)का नाम, संहार करनेवाले धनुर्धर; 'शर्व' (बहुवचन), अनेक रुद्र
śarva.en: Śarva, a name of Rudra-Śiva, the archer who destroys; 'the Śarvas', the many Rudras

śatrughna.hi: शत्रुघ्न, श्रीरामके सबसे छोटे भाई, सुमित्राके पुत्र
śatrughna.en: Śatrughna, Śrī Rāma's youngest brother, son of Sumitrā

śaṅkara.en: Śaṅkara, Śiva, the giver of good

śeṣa.hi: शेष, पृथ्वीको धारण करनेवाले हजार फनोंवाले नाग; लक्ष्मणजी उनके अवतार हैं
śeṣa.en: Śeṣa, the thousand-headed serpent who bears the earth; Lakṣmaṇa is his incarnation

śibi.hi: शिबि, वे राजा जिन्होंने शरणमें आये कबूतरको बचानेके लिये अपना मांस दे दिया
śibi.en: Śibi, the king who gave his own flesh to save a dove that had sought his shelter

śipiviṣṭa.en: Śipiviṣṭa, 'pervaded by rays': a name of Rudra (Śiva)

śivatara.en: Śivatara, 'more auspicious': a name of Śiva

śivānanda.hi: शिवानन्द स्वामी, अन्तिम पदमें आये इस आरतीके कवि
śivānanda.en: Śivānanda Svāmī, named in the last verse as the poet of this āratī

śiṃśapā.en: the śiṃśapā tree, the Indian rosewood (shisham, sissoo)

śrāddha.hi: श्राद्ध, पितरोंके लिये किया जानेवाला कर्म
śrāddha.en: the rite for one's dead ancestors, with offerings and the feeding of brāhmaṇas

śrīdhara.en: Śrīdhara, 'who holds Śrī (Lakṣmī)': a name of Viṣṇu

śuka.hi: शुक, रावणका दूत, जो श्रीरामकी सेनाका भेद लेने गया / शुकदेव मुनि, व्यासजीके पुत्र
śuka.en: Śuka, a messenger of Rāvaṇa who spied on Śrī Rāma's army / Śuka, the sage, son of Vyāsa

śvapaca.hi: श्वपच, 'कुत्ता पकानेवाला', सबसे नीचा माना गया अन्त्यज
śvapaca.en: a śvapaca, 'dog-cooker', an outcaste of the lowest station

śālagrāma.hi: शालग्राम, गण्डकी नदीका काला पवित्र पत्थर, जिसे विष्णुरूप मानकर पूजते हैं
śālagrāma.en: a sacred black stone from the Gaṇḍakī river, worshipped as Viṣṇu

śārṅga.hi: शार्ङ्ग, विष्णुका धनुष, यहाँ श्रीरामके हाथमें
śārṅga.en: Śārṅga, the bow of Viṣṇu, here held by Śrī Rāma

śūdra.hi: शूद्र, चौथा वर्ण, सेवा करनेवाला वर्ग
śūdra.en: a śūdra, one of the fourth varṇa, the class of service

śūrpaṇakhā.hi: शूर्पणखा, रावणकी बहन, जिसके नाक-कान लक्ष्मणजीने काटे; उसने खर, दूषण और रावणको भड़काया
śūrpaṇakhā.en: Śūrpaṇakhā, Rāvaṇa's sister, whose nose and ears Lakṣmaṇa cut off; she stirred up Khara, Dūṣaṇa and Rāvaṇa

śṛṅgaverapura.en: Śṛṅgaverapura, Guha's town on the bank of the Gaṅgā

ḍamaru.hi: डमरू, बीचमें पतला छोटा बाजा, जिसे शिवजी हाथमें रखते हैं
ḍamaru.en: a small drum shaped like an hourglass, as Śiva holds

ṛddhi.hi: ऋद्धि, समृद्धि, ऐश्वर्य; सिद्धियोंके साथ धन और शक्तियाँ
ṛddhi.en: prosperity, riches; with the siddhis, the powers that riches and spiritual practice bring

ṛṣyamūka.hi: ऋष्यमूक, पम्पा सरोवरके पासका पर्वत, जहाँ सुग्रीव वालीसे छिपकर रहते थे
ṛṣyamūka.en: Ṛṣyamūka, the mountain near Pampā where Sugrīva lived in hiding from Vāli
